handle_data_effects_objects: handle data effects objects for treescope rendering of EffectHandler, HandledEffectRef, and EffectRuntimeImpl nodes
build_handler_id_interceptor: build a handler_id_interceptor that colorizes handler ID strings in treescope tree nodes
track_known_handlers: track known effect handlers using a contextual value mapping handler IDs to their definition keypaths
render_handled_effect_ref: render HandledEffectRef nodes with constructor prefix, field children, background pattern, and handler comments
render_effect_runtime_impl: render EffectRuntimeImpl nodes as foldable tree with struct or dataclass constructor and colored background
